name: dataviz-palette-validator
why: The vendored copy IS the artifact. Its origin is a per-install path under /private/tmp carrying a CLI version and a content digest, not a re-fetchable URL, and just test's allow-read would not reach it in any case. The digest above is of these bytes, so a hand-edit is a red fixture case; nothing here re-derives it from the origin.
quotation: contrast() and validate() are exported and are called. deltaE() and simulate() are module-private, so tests/ground-truth.ts carries its own matrices and OKLab distance and is pinned to this file through validate()'s public report string. Exporting more from this file would turn the quotation into a fork.
